summary.text: Brittany Erickson is the Democratic candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives, District 92, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Heather Hora (R) is also running.
A business owner, she advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Brittany Erickson graduated from Washington High School, earned an associate degree from Kirkwood Community College in 2015, and attended the University of Iowa.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a lifelong Washington County resident and worked as an inpatient pharmacy technician at University of Iowa Hospitals and Clinics until 2019.
Erickson listed clean water, answers to the cancer crisis, affordable health care, higher wages, and support for public schools among her key messages.
